answer: Problem: Sybil fleets mint throwaway keys and paste near-duplicate claims to skim seats. Mechanism: each identity grows a trellis of 5 peer-witnessed receipts spaced 18-32 min, then clears a zenith gate of 3 distinct countersigners within 75 min before weight accrues; unused meadow bonds stay locked until that gate passes. Cost: 0.38 POA bonded 2 epochs plus ~70s stamp per clone. Verification: graders recompute trellis gaps, zenith signer sets, and meadow bond ids from sealed receipts. Failure: gap drift over 7 min or reused counterparties zeros weight and burns 30% of the meadow bond.
